@title TasksRunner
 @dev This contract manages a set of tasks that can be executed in batches.
      It allows adding, removing, and executing tasks, as well as checking their availability.
      Each task must implement the ITask interface, which requires a checkTask function to determine
      if the task should be executed, and a runTask function that performs the task and returns points earned.
      The contract also manages the execution of tasks based on signatures from oracles,
      ensuring that the execution is authorized and valid.

devdoc.details: This contract manages a set of tasks that can be executed in batches.      It allows adding, removing, and executing tasks, as well as checking their availability.      Each task must implement the ITask interface, which requires a checkTask function to determine      if the task should be executed, and a runTask function that performs the task and returns points earned.      The contract also manages the execution of tasks based on signatures from oracles,      ensuring that the execution is authorized and valid.

addTask(address).details: Only callable by an authorized changer.

params._task: The address of the task contract to be added.

returns._0: bool indicating whether any tasks are available.

params._task: The address of the task to check.

returns._0: bool indicating whether the task is registered.

params._index: The index of the task to retrieve.

returns._0: The address of the task at the specified index.
An array of addresses representing the tasks.
An array of addresses representing the tasks.

params._maxOraclesPerRound: The maximum count of oracles selected to participate each round.
params._maxSubscribedOraclesPerRound: The maximum count of subscribed oracles.
params._maxTasksPerBatch: The maximum number of tasks to be executed in a single batch.
params._name: The name used to identify the contract. Used same as coin pair identifier.
params._oracleManager: The contract of the oracle manager.
params._roundLockPeriod: The minimum time span for each round before a new one can be started, in seconds.
params._tasks: The initial list of task addresses to be added.
params._tokenAddress: The address of the MOC token to use.

isSubscribed(address).details: This is designed to be called from OracleManager.

params.oracleOwnerAddr: the oracle owner that is trying to withdraw

removeTask(address).details: Only callable by an authorized changer.

params._task: The address of the task contract to be removed.

params._blockNumber: The blocknumber acting as nonce to prevent replay attacks.
params._name: The contract name to report (must match this contract)
params._sigR: The array of R-component of Oracle signatures.
params._sigS: The array of S-component of Oracle signatures.
params._sigV: The array of V-component of Oracle signatures.
params._votedOracle: The address of the oracle voted as a publisher by the network.

setMaxTasksPerBatch(uint256).details: This function can only be called by an authorized changer.

params._maxTasksPerBatch: The maximum number of tasks to be executed in a single batch.

subscribe(address).details: This is designed to be called from OracleManager.

params.oracleOwnerAddr: the oracle address to subscribe to this coin pair.

unsubscribe(address).details: This is designed to be called from OracleManager.

addTask(address).notice: adds a new task to the runner.

areTasksAvailable().notice: Checks if any tasks are available to be executed.

changeIGovernor(address).notice: Change the contract's governor. Should be called through the old governance system

containsTask(address).notice: Checks if a specific task is registered in the runner.

delegateCallToChanger(bytes).notice: This method is used by a change contract to access the storage freely even without a setter.

getOracleRoundInfo(address).notice: Return round information for specific oracle

getSubscribedOracleAtIndex(uint256).notice: Returns the oracle owner address that is subscribed to this coin pair

getSubscribedOraclesLen().notice: Returns the amount of oracles subscribed to this coin pair.

getTaskAt(uint256).notice: Returns the address of a task at a specific index.

getTaskCount().notice: Returns the number of tasks currently registered in the runner.

getTasks().notice: Returns a list of all tasks currently registered in the runner.

getTasksAvailable().notice: Returns a list of all tasks available for execution.

governor().notice: The address of the contract which governs this one

isSubscribed(address).notice: Returns true if an oracle is subscribed to this contract' coin pair

onWithdraw(address).notice: The oracle owner has withdrawn some stake. Must check if the oracle is part of current round and if he lost his place with the new stake value (the stake is global and is saved in the supporters contract).

removeTask(address).notice: removes a task from the runner.

runTasks(uint256,bytes32,address,uint256.notice: Executes tasks based on the provided parameters and signatures.

setMaxTasksPerBatch(uint256).notice: Sets the maximum number of tasks that can be executed in a single batch.

subscribe(address).notice: subscribe an oracle to this coin pair , allowing it to be selected in rounds.

switchRound().notice: Switch contract context to a new round. With the objective of being a decentralized solution, this can be called by *anyone* if current round lock period is expired.

unsubscribe(address).notice: Unsubscribe an oracle from this coin pair , disallowing it to be selected in rounds.
